title: Rich Enough
medium: Mixed media on MDF, Epoxy & Resin
meta: Medium: Mixed media on MDF (plywood), Epoxy & Resin Coated
Framing: Handcrafted wooden frame, delivered ready to hang
statement:
This piece interrogates the notion of wealth — materially, emotionally, and socially. The textured phrase RICH ENOUGH? floats above a red and green color field, coated in resin like a luxury item. But beneath its glossy surface, tension builds: the word "rich" shines brightly, while the question mark turns it inward.

The textured surface and neon-toned lettering challenge notions of value, worth, and satisfaction. Is this about money? Or mindset? Success, fulfillment, self-worth? The viewer is left to decide and reflect.
